name: powershell
description: Runs PowerShell on this machine -- file and folder cleanup, disk space, process and service checks, quick system queries.
triggers: Clean up my downloads folder to make some disk space.
Free up disk space on my computer.
What's taking up all the space on my hard drive?
List the files in a folder.
Check if a program is running.
What processes are using the most memory right now?
Rename a bunch of files at once.
